name: work-break-rules
description: Does this shift give the breaks the law requires? US meal and rest break rules for adult employees — all 50 states and DC, plus federal law — as cited, dated data, with a checker for a planned shift or a day of clock punches: meal thresholds and timing windows, second meals, paid rest breaks, waivers, coverage limits, and California-style premium pay. Unknown places answer unknown, never 'no rule'. Pure functions, zero dependencies.
author: Drew Thomas <drew@drewthomasbuilds.com> (https://drewthomasbuilds.com)
